title: The mission is simple. Bring our people back to the one true God.  #PortAntsiranana #Madagascar
cleanTitle: The mission is simple. Bring our people back to the one true God.
segments: What I'm seeing as I walk through these
different places, as we walk, we
definitely see that our people are all
around this globe. Everywhere we go, we
see our people. I'm looking at people
that live right down the street from me.
Basically, our people are all over the
planet Earth. So when the Bible says go
ye to all nations, it means that because
that's why people are
scattered. It is up to us to follow
what's in that Bible to bring our people
back home. And that's the reason why
we're on a mission to establish
sanctuaries all over this planet. So
that's what we going to do. By the power
and the grace of the Most High, we're
going to get it done. I pray that my
brothers and sisters that see this, get
inspired.
